entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Incremental XAML Hot Reload (.uc.xsg.cs) generates invalid `this.Content = (IView)...` causing CS0266 (and surfaces as empty ENC1002) #36256

  • FlyoutHeader and FlyoutFooter broken in .NET 10 MAUI #36249

  • Framework-created dialogs do not respect application screen security settings, allowing dialog content to be captured in screenshots #36239
  • Custom Pin.ImageSource is ignored when clustering is enabled (Android) #36234
  • Regression in .NET MAUI 10.0.80: 'Page cannot be null here' crash when popping modal page on iPad #36233
